tools.name: token_verdict
tools.description: One-call verdict for an ERC-20 on Base: runs token risk, rug-pull, holder and momentum checks plus contract flags (proxy, blacklist, pause, selfdestruct) and returns avoid / high_risk / caution / low_risk with a one-line English summary. Use once before buying or listing an unknown Base token. $0.05

tools.name: token_risk
tools.description: Risk score 0-100 (higher = riskier) for an ERC-20 on Base: liquidity, top-5 holder concentration, honeypot/tax flags. Use before buying or listing an unknown Base token. $0.02 via x402. Not investment advice.

tools.name: rug_check
tools.description: Rug-pull check for an ERC-20 on Base: rug_pull true/false, confidence and 5 signals (liquidity removal, wash trading, LP lock, owner wallet, honeypot/tax). Use before buying a new Base token. $0.02 via x402.

tools.name: holder_check
tools.description: Holder analysis for an ERC-20 on Base: top 10 holders typed wallet/contract/LP/burn, wallet concentration, distribution and bundling check. Use to judge supply concentration. $0.02 via x402.

tools.name: momentum_score
tools.description: Momentum score 0-100 for an ERC-20 on Base from 24 h volume, volume vs liquidity and price change, with confidence low/medium/high. Null for stablecoins. Use to rank Base tokens by activity. $0.02 via x402.

tools.name: token_safety_demo
tools.description: Free demo (5 calls/day per IP): run one of token_verdict, token_risk, rug_check, holder_check, momentum_score without payment. Same output as the paid tool.
